name: telemed-platform
description: Web-Based Telemedicine Platform with React/Vite frontend, PHP API, and Socket.IO chat server

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:chat
scripts.dev: set CHAT_PORT=4311&& set VITE_CHAT_PORT=4311&& npm run dev:frontend
scripts.dev:https: set CHAT_PORT=4311&& set VITE_CHAT_PORT=4311&& set VITE_DEV_HTTPS=1&& npm run dev:frontend
scripts.dev:https:lan: set CHAT_PORT=4311&& set VITE_CHAT_PORT=4311&& cd frontend && set VITE_DEV_HTTPS=1&& node scripts/dev-server.mjs --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5174 --strictPort
